cynthia-gonzalez.text: Voted aye (Aug 4, 2026) to place a measure on the ballot requiring voter approval to raise Cudahy's 3% annual rent-increase ceiling and a 2/3 council vote to amend the rent stabilization chapter.

source.title: City of Cudahy - Resolution No. 26-34 (rent stabilization protection measure), adopted Aug 4, 2026

cynthia-gonzalez.text: Voted aye (Jul 21, 2026) to ask voters to continue Cudahy's existing 3/4% sales tax.

source.title: City of Cudahy - Resolution No. 26-30 (sales tax continuation measure), adopted Jul 21, 2026

martin-u-fuentes.text: Abstained (Aug 4, 2026) on placing the measure requiring voter approval to raise Cudahy's 3% rent-increase ceiling on the ballot.

source.title: City of Cudahy - Resolution No. 26-34 (rent stabilization protection measure), adopted Aug 4, 2026

martin-u-fuentes.text: Voted aye (Jul 21, 2026) to ask voters to continue Cudahy's existing 3/4% sales tax.
